name: topics
description: Subject topics of each article from its categories, its Wikidata item and its title, for weighting a school-oriented training mix. One JSON object per line (topics.jsonl), one per article of the corpus, in corpus order. See quality/topics.md.
source: orwiki-20260901: categories from the rendered HTML of the dump revision (raw/html); hidden categories and the category tree from the page, page_props, linktarget and categorylinks SQL dumps (reduced to raw/orwiki-20260901-category-graph.jsonl.gz); for articles without a direct category or title match, the Wikidata item from page_props (in raw/orwiki-20260901-article-facts.jsonl.gz) and its P31/P106/P2175/P279 fetched from the Wikidata API, wbgetentities (raw/orwiki-20260901-wikidata.jsonl.gz); annotate.py topics

columns.title: article title (Odia digits as ASCII)
columns.categories: visible content categories, in page order: hidden (hiddencat) and maintenance or tracking categories removed (JSON array; Odia digits as ASCII)
columns.topics: topics with enough evidence, strongest first (JSON array; vocabulary in 'topics' below)
columns.primary_topic: the strongest topic, or null when there is no evidence
columns.is_person: a biography: Wikidata P31 = human (Q5), else a people category (births, deaths, occupations, people of a place)
columns.odisha: Odisha-related: a category or the title names Odisha, Odia, Ollywood, Jagannath, Utkal, Kalinga or an Odisha district or city
columns.school_relevant: primary_topic is a school subject (science, biology, health, mathematics, technology, geography, history, politics, economy, literature, society, education), or arts/religion when odisha; for a biography only science, biology, health, mathematics, technology, history or literature
columns.topic_source: evidence behind primary_topic, '+'-joined: category (a rule on one of the article's categories), parent_category (a rule on a parent category up to 3 levels up), title (year or date page, or a '(qualifier)'), wikidata (P31/P106); 'none' when untagged
columns.wikidata: the article's Wikidata item (QID) from page_props, or null
columns.topic_scores: a string holding JSON {topic: score}: the summed evidence weights behind 'topics'

topics.calendar: year, date, month, decade and century pages; observances
topics.film: film, television and entertainment, including actors, directors, models
topics.health: health and medicine: diseases, drugs, anatomy, nutrition, hospitals
topics.biology: biology and nature: plants, animals, taxa, ecology, forests, sanctuaries
topics.science: physical and earth sciences: physics, chemistry, astronomy, geology, weather
topics.technology: technology and engineering: computing, internet, vehicles, transport, space tech
topics.economy: economy and business: companies, industry, agriculture, banking, trade
topics.religion: religion, mythology and philosophy: deities, temples, scriptures, saints
topics.literature: literature and language: writers, poets, books, periodicals, languages, scripts
topics.arts: arts and culture: music, dance, theatre, painting, festivals, food, customs, crafts
topics.history: history and military: empires, dynasties, rulers, wars, freedom struggle, monuments
topics.politics: politics, government and law: politicians, elections, legislatures, courts, schemes
topics.society: society: communities, tribes, castes, organisations, social movements, activists
topics.geography: geography and places: countries, states, districts, towns, villages, rivers
